options.text: Because the mind tends to fill in gaps and complete familiar shapes

questions.stem: On Continuity flow: a designer reviewing a museum exhibition poster notices that a curved path of small dots leads the eye toward an important message. Which principle describes this guided eye movement?

options.text: Continuity, because the eye follows the smooth path the dots imply
Proximity, because the dots are spaced closely together
options.misconception: confuses nearness with a directed pathway for the eye

options.text: Closure, because the dots come together to form a closed loop
options.misconception: mistakes a flowing line for a fully completed shape

options.text: Similarity, because all the dots are the same size and color
options.misconception: treats identical elements as a guiding directional path

questions.explanation: Continuity describes the eye's preference to follow a smooth, directed path rather than an abrupt change of direction. A curved trail of dots leads the viewer along its trajectory, which designers use to direct attention toward a chosen target.
questions.hint: Which cue is about the direction the eye travels?
